title: Accept independent audit results and authorize ADR-0020 re-freeze
description:
Consume the independent candidate audit and decide whether the ADR-0020 truthfulness bar
is satisfied. Any substantive source/discovery/capability/adjudication/state defect blocks
re-freeze and receives durable ownership. The decision does not require proof that the
audit enumerated every possible mechanic or defect.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every independent-audit finding is explicitly dispositioned; no blocker is waived by aggregate green metrics.
- Known repaired defect classes have not recurred in the audited candidate.
- The candidate satisfies the ADR-0020 truthfulness bar for source fidelity, artifact scope, known findings, capabilities in force, state ownership, and explicit unresolved discovery/adjudication limits.
- Approval explicitly rejects universal deterministic/discovery/completeness claims.
- On success, eshyra-o9bd.14 is authorized to formalize this exact candidate.
notes:
